title: The Joy of the Church and the Resurrection
english: Regarding his commandments, he who does not keep them does not love God. These things should be said in the manner of a prayer to the Father: that God—who descended into death because of Christ's suffering, while his body lay in the tomb being despoiled by the Jews, who were gathered together with those filled with deceitful demons and other evil powers—may rise up; for man has become one who has descended into death, so that those gathered against him might be scattered. For then even those who hate him, being unable to look upon him when he rises from the dead, will flee from his face (Ps 67:3,4). Not as wickedness is destroyed, so is the virtue of the righteous; for it is written, 'His righteousness remains forever and ever.'

A testimony of wickedness being smoke is this: just as a harmful path is called a way and smoke harms the eyes, so lawlessness, used by those, harms the powers of the soul in the same way, which are figuratively called teeth, cutting and devouring the spiritual foods, and also the thoughts of the soul, which are called the mind. It is to be understood that the melting wax does not destroy itself into nothingness from his presence, but its essence is given over to the fire. Thus, even if the quality by which someone is a sinner is removed, his essence remains incorruptible.

It must also be seen that the sinners are not utterly destroyed nor excluded from the presence of God, since, having become such, they flee from his face because they hate him, and the lawless do not remain before his eyes. There is a joy, according to which the righteous rejoice before God; joy is one of the fruits of the Spirit (Gal 5:22): love, joy, peace, and gladness, which is the flowing of the soul's thinking, rightly called well-being. If anyone does the good without turning away from evil (for they are co-existing), nor is he enlightened by the sun of righteousness under the sun, participating...

What is the thing of the one transforming himself into a false light and mocking righteousness, while being called a light of impiety? For the light of the impious shall be extinguished. For as this one sinks, that one rises in our hearts, mounting upon his enemies.

Prepare the way for the one coming with the Lord's approach, according to Moses and the prophets, to mount upon enemies. Adam has been cast out from the paradise planted toward the east, to bring him again into the east, which even he has done, saying to the repentant thief, 'Today you shall be with me in paradise' (Ps 67:6a).

The Word gladdens those who are afflicted by Satan, exhorting them to rejoicings through the showing of their protector and helper, who is the father of orphans and judge of widows. Let there be a haste for you to rejoice before him, especially those having left the former father who begot according to wickedness and the first man living lawlessly with him; become orphans from him, for you shall have a father. But also the souls having separated themselves from the unlawful mixture will attempt to become slaves of the indwelling of God.

His holy place is found to be the church sanctified by Christ, which is each of the ones having believed; for it is true and both sides. And his holy place is also the one who has taken up not a soulless body but a rational one.

But also he brings out the dead from the tombs according to 'The dead shall rise, and those in the tombs shall be raised' (Ps 67:7bc); for the dew from you is life to them. This is like that in the Gospel, 'All those in the tombs shall hear his voice' (Ps 67:8), (meaning clearly the Son), and the ones having done good things shall go forth into a resurrection of life, but the ones having doing evil things into a resurrection of judgment.
For indeed, in the going forth of God before his people...
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
